voice_instructions: Measured, quiet, a little hushed — calm and unhurried, but with a touch more forward energy than a long documentary; the cold voice of something that read the whole file. Never sensational. Small pauses.

beats.vo: Lake Michigan, September sixteen seventy-nine. The Griffon, the first full-sized sailing ship on the upper Great Lakes, sailed from Washington Island for Niagara.
Her cargo was furs. Six men were aboard: her pilot, and five crew.
She never reached Niagara. No one aboard was ever seen again.
A friar from the expedition blamed a violent storm. La Salle believed his crew sank her, and took the furs. Neither was ever proven.
Wrecks in two lakes have been claimed as hers. None has ever been confirmed. The Griffon has never been found.
